```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(revtools)
library(synthesisr)
library(readr)
library(vroom)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
```

```{r file-paths, message=FALSE}
files = c(
Pubmed_path='/Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/personlig-datavitenskapsportef-lje/vr-psychosocial-dementia/data/raw/pubmed-DementiaMe-set.nbib',
Embase_path='/Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/personlig-datavitenskapsportef-lje/vr-psychosocial-dementia/data/raw/embase-DementiaMe-set.ris')
file.exists(files)
```

```{r import-records}
pubmed_records=synthesisr::read_refs(filename = files[['Pubmed_path']],locale = vroom::locale(encoding = 'UTF-8'))
embase_records=synthesisr::read_refs(filename = files[['Embase_path']],locale=vroom::locale(encoding='UTF-8'))
nrow(pubmed_records)
nrow(embase_records)
pubmed_records$database ='PubMed'
embase_records$database ='Embase'
```

```{r}
# Convert bibliographic fields into consistent character columns
to_character = function(x) {
  if (is.list(x)) {
    vapply(
      x,
      function(value) {
        value = unlist(
          value,
          recursive = TRUE,
          use.names = FALSE
        )
        value = value[!is.na(value)]
        if (length(value) == 0) {
          NA_character_
        } else {
          paste(as.character(value), collapse = '; ')
        }
      },
      character(1)
    )
  } else {
    as.character(x)
  }
}
# Harmonise PubMed fields
pubmed_prepared = pubmed_records %>% mutate(across(everything(), to_character), database = 'PubMed')
# Harmonise Embase fields
embase_prepared = embase_records %>% mutate(across(everything(), to_character),database = 'Embase')
# Combine the two databases
records_raw = bind_rows(pubmed_prepared,embase_prepared)
table(records_raw$database)
saveRDS(records_raw,'/Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/personlig-datavitenskapsportef-lje/vr-psychosocial-dementia/data/cleaned/records_raw_combined.rds')
```

```{r}
#Deduplicate
names(records_raw)
records_for_dedup=records_raw %>% mutate(record_id=row_number(), doi_clean=str_extract(str_to_lower(doi), '10\\.\\d{4,9}/[-._;()/:a-z0-9]+'),
pmid_clean=str_extract(pubmed_id, '\\d+'),
title_clean=title %>% str_to_lower() %>% str_replace_all('[^[:alnum:] ]', '') %>% str_squish(),
year_clean=str_extract(year, '\\d{4}')) %>% mutate(across(c(doi_clean, pmid_clean, title_clean, year_clean), ~na_if(.x, '')))
data.frame(field=c('DOI', 'PMID', 'Title','Year'), available=c(
  sum(!is.na(records_for_dedup$doi_clean)),
  sum(!is.na(records_for_dedup$pmid_clean)),
  sum(!is.na(records_for_dedup$title_clean)),
  sum(!is.na(records_for_dedup$year_clean))),
  missing=c(
    sum(is.na(records_for_dedup$doi_clean)),
    sum(is.na(records_for_dedup$pmid_clean)),
    sum(is.na(records_for_dedup$title_clean)),
    sum(is.na(records_for_dedup$year_clean))))
duplicate_summary=data.frame(
  match_field=c('DOI', 'PMID', 'Title'),
  duplicate_grouos=c(
    sum(table(records_for_dedup$doi_clean)>1),
    sum(table(records_for_dedup$pmid_clean)>1),
    sum(table(records_for_dedup$title_clean)>1)))
duplicate_summary
```

```{r}
#record duplicates 
title_duplicate_groups=records_for_dedup %>% 
  filter(!is.na(title_clean)) %>% 
  group_by(title_clean) %>%
  filter(n()>1) %>% 
  summarise(
    title=first(title),
    n_records=n(),
    databases=paste(sort(unique(database)),
    collapse='+'),
    years=paste(sort(unique(na.omit(year_clean))), 
    collapse = ';'),
    .groups='drop')
title_duplicate_overview=title_duplicate_groups %>% summarise(
  duplciate_group=n(),
  records_in_duplicate_groups=sum(n_records),
  potential_records_to_remove=sum(n_records-1),
  cross_database_groups=sum(str_detect(databases, 'PubMed') & str_detect(databases, 'Embase')))
title_duplicate_overview
```
```{r}
#remove duplicate
n_raw=nrow(records_for_dedup)
records_after_doi=deduplicate(
  data=records_for_dedup,
  match_by = 'doi_clean',
  method='exact',
  type='merge')
n_after_doi=nrow(records_after_doi)

records_after_pmid=deduplicate(
  data=records_after_doi,
  match_by = 'pmi_clean',
  method='exact',
  type='merge')
n_after_pmid=nrow(records_after_pmid)
records_after_pmid=records_after_pmid %>% mutate(
  title_match=if_else(!is.na(title_clean) & nchar(title_clean) >=20, 
  title_clean,
  paste0('unique_titl_', row_number())))

records_deduplicated=deduplicate(
  data=records_after_pmid,
  match_by = 'title_match', 
  method='exact',
  type='merge')
n_after_title=nrow(records_deduplicated)
```
```{r}
#summary
deduplication_summary <- data.frame(
  stage = c(
    'Before deduplication',
    'After DOI matching',
    'After PMID matching',
    'After exact-title matching'),
  records_remaining = c(
    n_raw,
    n_after_doi,
    n_after_pmid,
    n_after_title),
  records_removed_at_stage = c(
    0,
    n_raw - n_after_doi,
    n_after_doi - n_after_pmid,
    n_after_pmid - n_after_title))
deduplication_summary
```

```{r}
#title and abstract screen
screening_data <- records_deduplicated %>%
  mutate(
    screening_id = sprintf(
      'VRD%04d',
      row_number()
    ),
    title = str_squish(title),
    abstract = str_squish(abstract),
    title_abstract = str_c(
      coalesce(title, ''),
      coalesce(abstract, ''),
      sep = ' '
    ),
    # Used only to prioritise screening, not automatic exclusion
    psychosocial_priority = str_detect(
      title_abstract,
      regex(
        paste(
          c(
            'psychosocial',
            'social',
            'reminisc',
            'well-being',
            'wellbeing',
            'quality of life',
            'depress',
            'anxi',
            'apathy',
            'agitat',
            'affect',
            'mood',
            'loneliness',
            'interaction',
            'communication',
            'engagement',
            'withdrawal'
          ),
          collapse = '|'
        ),
        ignore_case = TRUE
      )
    ),
    screening_decision = NA_character_,
    exclusion_reason = NA_character_,
    screening_notes = NA_character_
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(psychosocial_priority),
    title
  ) %>%
  select(
    screening_id,
    database,
    title,
    abstract,
    author,
    year,
    journal,
    publication_type,
    doi_clean,
    pmid_clean,
    psychosocial_priority,
    screening_decision,
    exclusion_reason,
    screening_notes
  )
nrow(screening_data)
table(
  screening_data$psychosocial_priority,
  useNA = 'ifany'
)
sum(is.na(screening_data$abstract))
saveRDS(screening_data,'/Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/personlig-datavitenskapsportef-lje/vr-psychosocial-dementia/data/cleaned/screening_data.rds')
write.csv(screening_data,'/Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/personlig-datavitenskapsportef-lje/vr-psychosocial-dementia/data/cleaned/screening_data.csv',row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = 'UTF-8')
```

```{r}
# 
screening <- read_csv(
  '/Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/personlig-datavitenskapsportef-lje/vr-psychosocial-dementia/data/processed/vr_dementia_title_abstract_screening_assisted.csv',
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
# 
candidate_base <- screening %>%
  filter(suggested_decision %in% c('selected', 'uncertain')) %>%
  mutate(
    text = str_to_lower(
      str_c(
        coalesce(title, ''),
        coalesce(abstract, ''),
        sep = ' '
      )
    ),
    # 
    study_key = if_else(
      !is.na(possible_report_family) &
        possible_report_family != '',
      possible_report_family,
      screening_id
    ),
    design_group = case_when(
      str_detect(text, 'cross[- ]?over|crossover') &
        str_detect(text, 'random') ~ 'randomized_crossover',

      str_detect(text, 'randomi[sz]|\\brct\\b') ~
        'randomized_parallel_or_unclear',

      str_detect(text, 'controlled trial|control group|comparator') ~
        'nonrandomized_controlled',

      str_detect(text, 'single[- ]arm|pre[- ]?post|pilot|feasibility') ~
        'single_arm_or_pilot',

      TRUE ~ 'unclear'
    ),
    # intervention type
    reminiscence = str_detect(
      text,
      'reminisc|autobiograph|nostalgi|life stor'
    ),
    nature_relaxation = str_detect(
      text,
      'nature|forest|garden|beach|landscape|relax|calm'
    ),
    social_dyadic = str_detect(
      text,
      'dyad|caregiver|family|social interact|interpersonal|multi-user'
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    other_vr = !reminiscence &
      !nature_relaxation &
      !social_dyadic
  )
# 
candidate_interventions <- candidate_base %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      reminiscence,
      nature_relaxation,
      social_dyadic,
      other_vr
    ),
    names_to = 'intervention_group',
    values_to = 'has_intervention'
  ) %>%
  filter(has_intervention)
# 
meta_candidates <- candidate_interventions %>%
  mutate(
    engagement = str_detect(
      text,
      'engagement|participation'
    ),
    apathy = str_detect(
      text,
      'apathy|apathetic'
    ),
    agitation_aggression = str_detect(
      text,
      'agitat|aggress|\\bbpsd\\b|neuropsychiatric'
    ),
    depression_anxiety_mood = str_detect(
      text,
      'depress|anxi|mood|affect|emotion'
    ),
    quality_of_life = str_detect(
      text,
      'quality of life|\\bqol\\b|well-being|wellbeing'
    ),
    social_outcomes = str_detect(
      text,
      paste0(
        'social engagement|social interaction|',
        'loneliness|social isolation|conversation|communication'
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      engagement,
      apathy,
      agitation_aggression,
      depression_anxiety_mood,
      quality_of_life,
      social_outcomes
    ),
    names_to = 'outcome_group',
    values_to = 'has_outcome'
  ) %>%
  filter(has_outcome) %>%
  #
  filter(
    design_group %in% c(
      'randomized_crossover',
      'randomized_parallel_or_unclear',
      'nonrandomized_controlled'
    )
  ) %>%
  #
  distinct(
    study_key,
    intervention_group,
    outcome_group,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )
#
meta_groups <- meta_candidates %>%
  group_by(intervention_group, outcome_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_independent_studies = n_distinct(study_key),
    designs = str_c(
      sort(unique(design_group)),
      collapse = '; '
    ),
    screening_ids = str_c(
      sort(unique(screening_id)),
      collapse = '; '
    ),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  filter(n_independent_studies >= 2) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_independent_studies))
meta_groups
write_csv(meta_groups,'procssed/potential_meta_groups.csv')
```

## R Markdown
This document imports bibliographic records retrieved from PubMed, Embase and PsycINFO and combines them into a single dataset prior to deduplication.
